name: Thai Coconut Shrimp Curry with Basmati Rice

instructions.primary_message: Rinse rice in a strainer until water runs clear and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, stir, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cups water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place in a medium bowl, cover with cold water, and set aside to thaw. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium-high heat.
Wash, seed, and julienne (cut into thin sticks) bell peppers. Wash and small dice tomatoes.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add pepper and, stirring frequently, cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger

instructions.primary_message: Add garlic, ginger, curry, and red pepper to pan. Cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp curry powder
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and coconut milk. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until sauce thickens slightly, 5-6 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Drain and rinse shrimp under cold water until there are no more ice chunks. Place on paper towels and pat dry. If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.
Add shrimp and ½ of the cilantro (save the rest for garnishing) to pan and stir. Cook until shrimp are opaque, 2-3 minutes.
Add lime juice and season with salt. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ limes
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Uncover rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice in a bowl, top with curry, and garnish with remaining cilantro and lime wedges. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
